user.title: BTicino C300X
user.description: Enter the C300X address first. If the native device agent is not reachable, Home Assistant can guide a one-shot agent install before collecting tokens and feature options.

data.name: Name
data.callback_base_url: Address of Home Assistant for the C300X (optional)

data_description.agent_host: IP address or host name of your C300X.
data_description.agent_port: Port the C300X answers Home Assistant on. Leave it at 8091 unless you changed it during installation.
data_description.callback_base_url: The C300X reports rings and other events to this address. Leave it empty to use the address Home Assistant knows for itself. An https address encrypts the connection; it needs a valid certificate and puts more load on the C300X. Switching between http and https restarts the service on the C300X once no call or stream is running.

agent_missing.title: Native agent not found
agent_missing.description: Home Assistant could not reach the C300X native agent at the configured address. You can install the bundled native agent now, or continue if you want to configure an already installed agent manually.

data.bootstrap_install_agent: Install native agent on the C300X

bootstrap_install.title: Install native C300X agent
bootstrap_install.description: This writes the native agent, generated token config, startup script, and display support files to the C300X through SSH. SSH credentials are used only for this install step and are not stored.

agent_auth.title: Device agent credentials
agent_auth.description: Enter the token details for the reachable native agent. Leave the API token empty only while the agent is still in noAuth bootstrap mode.

data_description.agent_token: Key Home Assistant signs in to the C300X with. It was created during installation.
data_description.maintenance_token: Separate key for maintenance: updates, display changes and restarts.

user_features.title: BTicino C300X features
user_features.description: Select the Home Assistant media features exposed by this C300X installation.

data.create_homeassistant_user: Set up video and audio access on the C300X
data.webrtc_ice_policy: Connection paths for the live picture
data.native_two_way_audio: Talk through the Home Assistant camera view

data_description.video_enabled: Picture and sound of the door station in Home Assistant: on a ring, on demand and for Home Call.
data_description.create_homeassistant_user: Video and audio need an access of their own on the C300X. With this on, the integration sets it up during setup or through its repair.
data_description.doorstation_audio_gain_db: Level of the door station's sound in the live view and during a call. -20 to +20 dB; 0 leaves the sound unchanged.
data_description.ring_capture_audio_gain_db: Volume of the sound in recordings made when someone rings. -20 to +20 dB; the default is 6.
data_description.webrtc_ice_policy: Which network addresses the browser may use for the live picture. Change this only when the live picture does not connect.
data_description.native_two_way_audio: Optional, off by default. Requires Home Assistant 2026.11 or later, "Two-way audio" switched on under Settings > System > Labs, the live picture over WebRTC, access over HTTPS and the browser allowed to use the microphone. Answer a call in the C300X card first; this option does not answer it. Talking in the C300X card stays as it is.

user_device_activations.title: Additional device activations

data_description.device_activation_mode: Automatic uses the activations as set up here or reported by the device. Manual adds a stair-light activation built from the P and N values below.
data_description.device_activation_stair_light_p: Manual mode only: P part of the stair-light address, 0 to 99.
data_description.device_activation_stair_light_n: Manual mode only: N part of the stair-light address, 0 to 99.
data_description.device_activation_flow_action: Add, edit or remove an activation - or finish and save.
data_description.device_activation_flow_target: The activation to edit or remove.

data_description.device_activation_item_id: Letters, numbers, _ and -, up to 32 characters. Each ID can be used once.
data_description.device_activation_item_name: Name of the button in Home Assistant, up to 63 characters.
data_description.device_activation_item_type: What the address triggers: a door lock, a light or the stair light.
data_description.device_activation_item_address: Address in the door system the activation is sent to (OpenWebNet "where"), up to 31 characters.

user_dashboard_alarm.title: Alarm (Alarmo)
user_dashboard_alarm.description: Alarmo drives the alarm commands and the Alarm page of the display, which opens from the Alarm button on the home page of the C300X. Choose the Alarmo alarm panel and, if you like, a quick action beside it on the Alarm page.

data_description.alarm_entity_id: Alarm panel that Home Assistant arms and disarms from the C300X and the Alarm page shows. Leave empty if you do not use Alarmo: the Alarm button then does not appear.
data_description.alarm_page_entity_id: Optional entity on the Alarm page of the display (Display patch), for example the stair light. Buttons, switches, scenes and scripts can be operated there, other entities are only shown. Leave empty to hide it.

user_dashboard.title: C300X display dashboard
user_dashboard.description:
Configure the optional C300X display dashboard and Display patch.

Current Display patch status: {qml_patch_status}.

Applying or restoring the Display patch writes display files on the device, reloads the device UI, and can take up to about 60 seconds. The status changes only after the agent confirms the resulting state.

With the Display patch applied, the next step sets up the display pages: the weather and the entities on each page.

data.device_ui_enabled: Home Assistant pages on the display
data.dashboard_dynamic_homepage: Show home page buttons only when needed
data.dashboard_prevent_return: Stay on the page after an action

data_description.device_ui_enabled: On: installs the Home Assistant pages on the display of the C300X (Display patch). Off: restores the original display and discards the alarm, weather, page and tile settings.
data_description.dashboard_dynamic_homepage: On: the Alarm and Home Assistant buttons appear on the home page of the C300X only while they have something to open, next to the original buttons. Off: both are always shown as a fixed pair. A change applies the Display patch again and restarts the display once.
data_description.actions_json: Actions the display and its notifications may run, written as JSON: one entry per action with domain and service, optionally target and data. Leave empty if you use none.
data_description.dashboard_prevent_return: On: the display stays on the Home Assistant page after an action instead of returning to the home page.

user_dashboard_entity_display.title: Display tiles
user_dashboard_entity_display.description:
Each tile has its own section, in the order the display shows them: first the page, then the entity. Open a section to change its tile.

- **Width** and **Height**: half or full. Automatic uses the usual size of the entity type. At full height the tile carries the entity's own buttons.
- **Name**: the name from Home Assistant or the entity ID - or simply type a text of your own.
- **Secondary line**: the second line below the name.

The Alarmo quick action is on no page; it has a name and a secondary line only.

user_dashboard_pages.title: Display pages
user_dashboard_pages.description:
Set up to 8 pages for the display. Each page is one section:

- **Name**: shown as the page heading on the display.
- **Position**: order of the pages, 1 is the first. Left empty, the section's number is used.
- **Entities**: shown as tiles in the order they are picked; drag them to reorder. An entity can be on one page only.

A section without a name and entities stays unused. Alarmo has an area of its own in the settings menu.

agent_capability_mismatch.title: C300X device agent capabilities are missing
agent_capability_mismatch.description: The configured C300X device agent for {entry_title} answered without usable capabilities. Update or reconfigure the local device agent, then reload the integration.

error.ssh_install_failed: The SSH repair install failed. Check SSH access and retry.
error.update_failed: The device-agent update failed. Check that maintenance access is enabled and retry.
error.update_verify_failed: The update was sent, but the agent still reports an older or incompatible bundle.

abort.entry_not_loaded: The BTicino C300X entry is not loaded.

device_agent_startup_disabled.title: C300X device agent does not start after reboot
device_agent_startup_disabled.description: {entry_title} can reach the C300X device agent now, but the device startup link is missing or invalid. The agent will stop working again after the next C300X reboot. Run the device-agent repair/update action or reinstall the agent over SSH to recreate the startup link.

device_agent_self_test_failed.title: C300X device agent self-test found a problem
device_agent_self_test_failed.description: {entry_title} reached the C300X device agent, but the read-only self-test reported a failed setup check. Failed checks: {failed_checks}. Reasons: {reasons}. What to do: {actions}. No automatic repair was run. IPv6 firewall is optional unless this HA instance reaches the device over IPv6.

device_agent_ui_event_watchdog.title: C300X display event watcher was protected
device_agent_ui_event_watchdog.description: {entry_title} detected too many simultaneous C300X display event watchers. The device agent rejected the extra watcher to prevent a local display polling loop that can overload the C300X. Active watchers: {waiters}/{capacity}. Rejected watchers: {overflows}. Reload the C300X display GUI from the integration if the display dashboard or memo view no longer updates, then refresh diagnostics.

device_core_qml_hook_required.title: C300X core media hook is missing

confirm.title: Apply C300X core media hook
confirm.description:
Home Assistant will apply only the minimal core media hook required to detect when the C300X display or another media client closes a media session. This is separate from the optional dashboard display patch.

Current core hook state: {qml_patch_status}

error.core_patch_failed: Applying the core media hook failed. Check maintenance access and retry.
error.core_patch_verify_failed: The core media hook action ran, but the agent did not confirm the patched state.

abort.entry_not_loaded: The BTicino C300X entry is not loaded.
abort.core_patch_unsupported: The installed C300X device agent does not support applying the core media hook.

confirm.title: Create Home Assistant media user
confirm.description: Home Assistant will ask the device agent to create or repair the dedicated `homeassistant` C300X media user. Existing media users are kept. The agent writes only the required device-side user and routing state.

invalid_action_map.title: C300X dashboard action allowlist is invalid
invalid_action_map.description: The action allowlist for {entry_title} cannot be parsed: {error}. Fix the configured action map, then reload the integration.

missing_alarm_entity.title: Configured C300X alarm entity is missing
missing_alarm_entity.description: {entry_title} references {entity_id}, but Home Assistant does not know that entity. Pick an existing alarm control panel entity in the integration options or clear the alarm setting.

media_watchdog_timeout.title: C300X media watchdog stopped a high-load session
media_watchdog_timeout.description: {entry_title} reported sustained device CPU load for at least {duration_seconds} seconds ({cpu_percent}%). Home Assistant closed its active C300X media sessions to avoid keeping the device under load. Reason: {reason}.

init.title: Set up the C300X Lovelace card
init.description: This update requires the generated C300X Lovelace cards to be refreshed. Run this repair once to update the C300X dashboard view at {dashboard_path} and replace old generated split-card layouts. Ignore it only if you already updated every C300X card manually.

confirm.title: Create or refresh the C300X Lovelace card
confirm.description: Home Assistant will add or update a C300X view in a storage-mode Lovelace dashboard. The view contains the consolidated Doorstation/Home Call card for {entry_title}. Older generated split-card layouts in the selected dashboard are replaced.

error.camera_entity_missing: Home Assistant could not find the C300X camera entity for this config entry.
error.lovelace_config_invalid: The selected Lovelace dashboard config is not writable in the expected format.
error.lovelace_storage_unavailable: No storage-mode Lovelace dashboard is available. YAML dashboards must be edited manually.

unsupported_callback_url.title: C300X callback URL is not usable by the device agent

configure.title: Configure local callback URL
configure.description:
Enter a Home Assistant base URL reachable from the C300X. HTTP keeps TLS disabled. HTTPS explicitly enables TLS and requires an updated agent and a trusted certificate matching the hostname. Changing HTTP/HTTPS modes restarts only the agent when media is idle; HTTPS adds device load. Check DNS and device time if delivery fails.

Suggested value: {suggested_callback_base_url}

error.invalid_callback_base_url: Enter a reachable Home Assistant HTTP or HTTPS base URL.

capture_doorbell_call.description: Record a short video on Home Assistant from an incoming ring call or an idle on-demand stream.

capture_mode.name: Capture mode
capture_mode.description: Ring records an incoming call. On-demand records without ringing when no other media session is active.
